matter_background.original: Shantha Silva is a Notary practicing in Colombo. Cyril Construction (Private) Limited agreed to construct a business premises on a land situated in Matara belonging to Russel Perera. The Company wants Shantha Silva to attest the Agreement. Shantha Silva knows the directors of the said Company. However, he does not know the client Russel Perera who wish to construct a commercial building on his land. Russel Perera wants his Notary Ruwan Perera who is practicing in Matara to attest his signature.
